Name: Sensor Field Alignment Data TRE
Description: The Sensor Field Alignment Data TRE (CSSFAA) provides information on detectors, sensor type, and field alignment including fields for the focal length and principal point offset components. This TRE provides global information for the entire NITF dataset.

NUM_BANDS.Name: Number of Bands
NUM_BANDS.Description: This field represents the number of bands present.

BAND_TYPE<NUM_BANDS>.Name: Band Category
BAND_TYPE<NUM_BANDS>.Description: This field represents the category of band for which data is being supplied (PAN = M, MS = R,G,B,N,space).

BAND_ID<NUM_BANDS>.Name: Band Center of Wavelength
BAND_ID<NUM_BANDS>.Description: This field represents the band center of wavelength.

FOC_LENGTH<NUM_BANDS>.Name: Focal Length
FOC_LENGTH<NUM_BANDS>.Description: This field represents the focal length.

NUM_DAP<NUM_BANDS>.Name: Number of Linear Arrays
NUM_DAP<NUM_BANDS>.Description: This field represents the number of linear arrays (pairs) for a band for a Basic product only.

NUM_FIR<NUM_BANDS>.Name: First Sample Number
NUM_FIR<NUM_BANDS>.Description: This field represents the first sample number.

DELTA<NUM_BANDS>.Name: Focal Length
DELTA<NUM_BANDS>.Description: This field represents the number of detector elements in a linear array.

OPPOFF_X<NUM_BANDS>.Name: Principal Point Offset X
OPPOFF_X<NUM_BANDS>.Description: This field represents the principal point offset X.

OPPOFF_Y<NUM_BANDS>.Name: Principal Point Offset Y
OPPOFF_Y<NUM_BANDS>.Description: This field represents the principal point offset Y.

OPPOFF_Z<NUM_BANDS>.Name: Principal Point Offset Z
OPPOFF_Z<NUM_BANDS>.Description: This field represents the principal point offset Z.

START_X<NUM_BANDS>.Name: First X Pixel
START_X<NUM_BANDS>.Description: This field represents the detector mounting of the first pixel in the pair - x.

START_Y<NUM_BANDS>.Name: First Y Pixel
START_Y<NUM_BANDS>.Description: This field represents the detector mounting of the first pixel in the pair - y.

FINISH_X<NUM_BANDS>.Name: Last X Pixel
FINISH_X<NUM_BANDS>.Description: This field represents the detector mounting of the last pixel in the pair - x.

FINISH_Y<NUM_BANDS>.Name: Last Y Pixel
FINISH_Y<NUM_BANDS>.Description: This field represents the detector mounting of the last pixel in the pair - y.
